abstract: Three cases of pure dysgerminoma concomitant with pregnancy were managed by conservative surgery and term delivery. One woman with advanced disease received chemotherapy for the last trimester. Tumor response, measured by normalization of the serum tumor markers CA 125 and lactic dehydrogenase, was confirmed by magnetic resonance imaging.
abstract_ja: 妊娠中に発見された純粋型のディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)の3症例に、保存的手術と正期産分娩を行った。進行例の1例は妊娠最終期に化学療法を受けた。腫瘍マーカーであるCA 125と乳酸脱水素酵素の正常化により腫瘍反応を評価し、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で確認した。
